name: Metheptazine
summary: Metheptazine is an opioid analgesic from the phenazepane family. It was developed by American Home Products in the 1950s.

pharmacology.text: Metheptazine produces similar effects to other opioids, including analgesia, sedation, dizziness and nausea.

uses.text: It was developed by American Home Products in the 1950s.

sideEffects.en: Like other opioids it causes sedation, dizziness and nausea, and it can slow breathing, which can be dangerous. Regular use can lead to dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 和其他鴉片類一樣，它會引起鎮靜、頭暈與噁心，也可能使呼吸減慢，可能有危險。經常使用可能導致依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 和其他鸦片类一样，它会引起镇静、头晕与恶心，也可能使呼吸减慢，可能有危险。经常使用可能导致依赖。

fact.en: Metheptazine is built on a seven-membered nitrogen ring, a stretched version of the six-membered piperidine ring in pethidine. It was developed by American Home Products, the company later renamed Wyeth.
fact.zh: Metheptazine 以含氮七元環為骨架，相當於把配西汀的六元哌啶環撐大。它由美國家用產品公司研發，這家公司後來改名為惠氏。
fact.zhHans: Metheptazine 以含氮七元环为骨架，相当于把配西汀的六元哌啶环撑大。它由美国家用产品公司研发，这家公司后来改名为惠氏。
